name: Oda Subaru
source:
Subaru is good-looking and popular with women, but he's superficial. However, because he is good at keeping up appearances, Subaru has few enemies. Due to Saki, he hasn't got a girlfriend. Even though Saki is willing to have as much sex with him as he likes, he still wants more, and seeks other women.

[Taken from the [url=http://nekomarudow.com/y/]official website[/url]]
